deviations.reason: A literal in-place replacement changes the exported signatures of spec.ParseRequirementSet, spec.ParseDelta and spec.Fold (from *RequirementSet/*Delta to *LivingSpec/*SpecDelta) and deletes lines.go helpers that are still live. Those symbols are consumed OUTSIDE M2's path-set and outside M2's milestone: internal/archive/archive.go (lines 96/129/137/141) is retargeted by NO milestone (M5 only touches its step-completion gate), and internal/guard/replay.go (lines 96/102/113) is retargeted in M4. Literal replacement would (1) permanently break internal/archive, (2) do M4 (guard) and M3 (render.go + delete obsolete round-trip/render tests) and M8 (delete conformance_test.go) work early, and (3) make M2's OWN contract 'go test ./internal/spec/...' unbuildable, since render.go and the render_test/roundtrip_test/conformance_test/fuzz_test files still reference the markdown model and .Render(). The additive approach is the only way to satisfy every M2 validation-contract criterion (go test ./internal/spec/... and ./internal/validate/... green; refine reads spec.yaml; malformed YAML named by offending path) without crossing milestone boundaries. Per working rules 3, 4 and 5 this is a logged departure, not a silent decision or a guess.

If instead the reviewer wants the literal aggressive replacement (accepting transient breakage of internal/archive+internal/guard resolved by M3/M4/M8), that is a materially larger blast radius spanning five packages and three later milestones, and M2's own 'go test ./internal/spec/...' criterion could not be met until M3's render retarget also lands.
deviations.resolution: APPROVED (orchestrator, next-attempt guidance): additive approach taken. Implemented as: internal/spec/fold_yaml.go adds ParseLivingSpecYAML, ParseDeltaYAML (yaml.Unmarshal + duplicate-requirement rejection + ported RFC-2119 and >=1-scenario content checks), and FoldYAML (four-op structured fold, fixed RENAMED->REMOVED->MODIFIED->ADDED order, requirement-name key, structured empty base for nil) alongside the untouched markdown engine (parse.go/delta.go/fold.go/lines.go/render.go left intact for M3/M4/M8). internal/validate/delta.go retargeted to specs/<cap>/spec.yaml via the M1 schema-validate+ParseDeltaYAML path (malformed YAML surfaced naming the file path; findSpecFiles/spec.md retained for HasSpecsDeltas). internal/validate/types.go refine glob -> specs/**/spec.yaml. Verified: `go test ./internal/spec/...`, `./internal/validate/...`, `./internal/archive/...`, `./internal/guard/...` all pass; `CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./...` succeeds.
deviations.resolutionNote: Correction/completion to the pre-approval blast-radius claim 'every non-M2 package test stays green': that claim was WRONG. The mandated refine-stage retarget (specs/<cap>/spec.md -> specs/<cap>/spec.yaml, implemented in internal/validate/delta.go validateSpecsDeltas and the refine glob in internal/validate/types.go ArtifactsForStage) is an approved M2 deliverable (tasks.md M2 step 4), and it necessarily invalidates test FIXTURES in three out-of-M2-path packages. SHARED MECHANISM (stated once): each of these fixtures constructs a change carrying a markdown spec.md delta and drives it through the refine/approve gate, which now requires a spec.yaml delta; the gate therefore emits 'specs/ is present but contains no spec.yaml delta files (spec-lifecycle.md §4)' and the fixture fails. COMPLETE enumeration of the out-of-path fixtures invalidated (re-verified via `go test` on 2026-07-27): (1) internal/approve — approve_test.go: 8 failing tests (TestApproveConsentStrictWithApproveFlagSucceeds, TestApproveConsentOffProceedsWithoutApprove, TestApproveHashesRealFileContent, TestApproveConstitutionHashOmittedWithWarningWhenAbsent, TestApproveConstitutionHashPopulatedWhenPresent, TestAppendEntryIsAppendOnly, TestHashDriftDetectsEditAndDeletion, TestApproveConstitutionHashReadErrorSurfacesAsErrCouldNotRun). (2) internal/status — status_test.go: 4 failing tests (TestChangeApprovedAndPending, TestChangeDesignSkippedIsNotPending, TestChangeLatestEntryWins, TestChangeFlagsPostGateDrift). (3) cmd/lifecycle — 6 failing testscripts, named explicitly: testdata/script/{validate_refine_happy, validate_change_flag_and_warnings, init_fresh_reinit_byte_identical, approve_drift, approve_design_skip, approve_consent}.txtar (each emits 'specs/ is present but contains no spec.yaml delta files'). DEFERRAL: re-authoring every one of these out-of-path fixtures to spec.yaml traces to NO M2 task; per the tasks.md bootstrap note it is Milestone 8 work (re-author this repo's own live specs and archived deltas to YAML). Per the path-set rule and the prime directive I did NOT edit them. DELIBERATE PHASED STATE: for M2 the full-tree `go test ./...` is INTENTIONALLY RED — this is the expected, disclosed state, not an escaped regression. Only M2's own validation-contract packages must be green: `go test ./internal/spec/...` and `./internal/validate/...` both pass (and ./internal/archive/... and ./internal/guard/... also stay green). Full-tree `go test ./...` green is an explicit Milestone 8 deliverable ('the corpus is gone and the whole suite passes'). (internal/scaffold skills_test.go failures are pre-existing on the M1 baseline and unrelated to M2.) Surfaced here and in the halt report for observability.
